title: Erasure-Coded WSV
summary: World State View snapshots in SORA Nexus protected by erasure coding, enabling resilient state recovery across validators even when some nodes are offline or corrupted.
definition: World State View snapshots in SORA Nexus protected by erasure coding, enabling resilient state recovery across validators even when some nodes are offline or corrupted.
